body:
Dear all,

see https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/32503

Experimental annotations that need to be reviewed are here: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1x-r1CyXV4PG_p2KBBhmplYlprNPC_ylYGaKX-meT-t0/edit?gid=0#gid=0

Impacted groups: 
MGI 1

Mappings that need to be reviewed: (InterPro2GO, UniProt-Keywords, UniRule) 

term	file	line
GO:0030701	interpro2go	InterPro:IPR009953 Dinitrogenase reductase ADP-ribosyltransferase > GO:NAD+-dinitrogen-reductase ADP-D-ribosyltransferase activity ; GO:0030701

** Group contacts: https://github.com/geneontology/go-site/blob/master/metadata/group-contacts.csv
----




Thanks.
